expectations.text: An MP4 exists under videos/ in the product repo, 1920x1080, with an audio stream
Total length is at most 60 seconds (plus 2 s tolerance)
Narration is in English and uses only '(Premium)' voices
expectations.evidence: English narration; Ava, Lee, Zoe premium

expectations.text: The video has a setup scene that shows the real commands from the Taskboard README (cp .env.example .env and docker compose up -d, or npm start)
expectations.evidence: scene 2 types 'cp .env.example .env' and 'docker compose up -d' with real compose output

expectations.text: Scene 3 is a live recording of the running Taskboard app, not an HTML mockup
Asked the user no questions (the user said to just do it) and lists assumptions in the final message
expectations.evidence: questions.md written but run proceeded; final message lists assumptions

expectations.text: README.md links the video directly under the first headline
The video does not use the AI look: no gradient backgrounds, glow, emoji or kinetic word-by-word captions in the scene CSS/HTML
expectations.evidence: styles: neutral bg, system font, no gradients/emoji; only text-shadow on unused caption class
